notes.title: Getting closer!!
notes.content:
"Tilebreaker Next Level" is progressing better and nearing completion. I have come a long way since the first "Tilebreaker", and all this timer and process has been an incredible learning experience, still with a lot to learn, but proud of the progress made so far. Stay tuned for updates as we approach the launch date, expected to be sometime next month on Steam.
